traditional: Action and heat combined with limitation and structure. Two malefics: demanding, and condition/sect decides how hard.

modern.blend: Drive meets limit. Disciplined endurance and the ability to pace yourself and keep going long after others quit.
modern.hard: Gas and brake at once: jerky, stop-start progress, frustration, and a need to avoid burning bridges in case of retreat.
modern.business: Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint.
